T-228 is now in review with no new code. The welcome email is already the Registered campaign built under T-234, so building the Orchestrator's separate `enrolWelcome()` would have duplicated it.

decisions.decision: Build all of it now against vendor-sim. 1) Add POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts to cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py, with upsert by email and a 409 to test retries. 2) In cloud/src, add enrolWelcome(): reuse tantraUrl and tantraHeaders from connectors/stack.ts. Call it from admin add (index.ts ~478), /cal/issue and /intake. Retry on 409, record 'welcome_enrolled' once per attendee, and re-post when a calendar link is rotated. 3) Admin, Cohort Settings: add one 'Tantra Messaging' section with the API key stored encrypted like other vault keys. T-234 reuses this same section. Once the key is saved, the agent creates the welcome campaign through the API and fills in its id. 4) Write welcome copy to COPY_RULES.md with no dashes, plus a WhatsApp step through Tantra. 5) Write probe-welcome-enrol.mjs, add it to the centre chain, then merge and deploy. 6) Once the key exists, test live with [email] and revert the test contact afterwards.
decisions.why: Owner model google-and-reminder-model (2026-10-07) says registrants are imported into Tantra campaigns. The 2026-10-09 autonomy rules say build fully. The only go-live input is a Tantra key that needs Adi's login. Sharing one field with T-234 means one ask instead of two.
